data.title: XPeng Shares Fall to Lowest Since October 2024 Despite Robotics Push | EV
data.description: XPeng's US-listed shares fell to their lowest level since October 2024 on Tuesday, two days before the Chinese carmaker launches the second of its two flagship SUVs and three weeks after investors valued its robotics arm at more than $6.3 billion.
data.author: Cláudio Afonso
